title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Payment Methods, Card Limit and Returned Payments
content:
**Business office cashiering standards — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** These figures hold for all six accommodation tiers.

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Accepted payment methods | Personal check, certified check, money order, ACH transfer, card |
| Largest single card payment | USD 7500.00 |
| Returned-payment fee (operator fee schedule), per dishonored payment | USD 30.00 |
| Dishonored payments after which only certified funds are accepted | 2 |
| Rolling lookback for counting dishonored payments | 12 calendar months |
| Methods accepted once certified funds are required | Certified check, money order |
| Order in which a payment without instructions is applied | Oldest service month first |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- A card payment of 7500.00 is within the limit; a single card payment of 7500.01 is not.
- A resident with 1 dishonored payment in the last 12 calendar months may still pay by personal check; with 2, only a certified check or a money order is accepted.
